NBL Rosetta Match

Source: R/nbl_rosetta.R
nbl_rosetta_match.Rd

One match's header: status, scores, clock, venue, season and teams. Box score and play-by-play: the match_* frames.

Endpoint: GET https://prod.rosetta.nbl.com.au/get/match/{match_id}/live/all

Usage

nbl_rosetta_match(match_id)

Arguments

match_id

(character required): DataCore fixture id of the match (match_id of nbl_rosetta_matches), a UUID, e.g. b217a699-4bef-11f0-bc08-933162362355.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with one row per match. Its columns are listed in return_columns (subset(return_columns, fn == "nbl_rosetta_match")) and in the searchable return columns article.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in nbl_rosetta_seasons().

See also

family_nbl_rosetta lists every function in this family.

Examples

# \donttest{
  try(nbl_rosetta_match(match_id = "b217a699-4bef-11f0-bc08-933162362355"))
#> ── NBL Rosetta match from prod.rosetta.nbl.com.au ─────────────── hoopR 3.2.0 ──
#> ℹ Data updated: 2026-11-13 18:58:04 UTC
#> # A tibble: 1 × 52
#>   org   match_id    match_status start_time_datetime match_type attendance clock
#>   <chr> <chr>       <chr>        <chr>               <chr>           <int> <chr>
#> 1 nbl   b217a699-4… complete     2025-12-18T10:30:00 regular         10802 00:0…
#> # ℹ 45 more variables: current_period <int>, clock_running <lgl>,
#> #   home_score <int>, away_score <int>, round <chr>, start_time <chr>,
#> #   status <chr>, external_media_id <chr>, match_slug <chr>, match_title <chr>,

#> #   season_competition_id <chr>, season_competition_name <chr>,
#> #   season_competition_gender <chr>, season_competition_league_name <chr>, …
# }
